スティックシェーカー作動

Questions and answers

What is スティックシェーカー作動?

In this glossary, スティックシェーカー作動 refers to: The activation of a device that rapidly vibrates the control column to warn the pilot of an impending aerodynamic stall.

How is スティックシェーカー作動 used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "回転中にスティックシェーカーが作動し、離陸を中止して滑走路を離脱しました。"

Definition

The activation of a device that rapidly vibrates the control column to warn the pilot of an impending aerodynamic stall.

Operational example

Stick shaker activated during rotation, we aborted take-off and vacated runway.
